title: El Faro Towers
visualBrief: Specific connected El Faro compound: both individually angled mapped 160m shafts, pale punched-window concrete frames, dark glazed inner strips/stepped upper storeys, closed roofs and pale louvered crowns, mapped high connector and two picture-led intermediate bridges, bounded entry canopies. Four existing shared concrete/window-grid/paint/membrane graphs. No neighboring high-rises, whole-block podium, ground-covering platform, copied signs/photo atlas, furnished interiors or construction cranes.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Q526622 retained reference lies within the distinctive pair. Standard Protomaps20261014 buildings35184495506605/35184628893115 (OSMways123417773/256804283) have separate rotated rectangles and160m values, connected by building_part35184628893116 (way256804284) at min_height147/height153. Ordinary front/reverse pictures identify this connected pair. These native geometries control the two separate orientations and bridge, not a generic twin box. Live OSM tags were rate limited and no exact live Wikidata-tag check is claimed. Fine facade allocation retains20degree/2m approximation.
